description: Documents, medicine, money, one photograph. Everything that constitutes a family's evidence of itself either fits or does not. People report remembering what they left for the rest of their lives.
energy_note: A lifetime edited down in sixty minutes.

aspect: Documents are the difference between a person and a case number
description: A birth certificate, a deed, a degree. Without them the person abroad cannot prove they are who they say, owned what they owned, or studied what they studied, and no authority abroad will take their word for it.
money_note: Replacing or legalising documents from outside the country.
energy_note: Erased on paper while still alive.
notes: Links directly to assets/text/iran ADM and name-mismatch issues.

description: One move is a rupture. Seven is a condition. In Gaza, 95.3% of children in one displaced cohort had lost their homes and had experienced an average of nearly seven forced migrations.
energy_note: Unpacking stops being something you do.
source_name: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Mental Health, 2026

aspect: SCENARIO - the bag that was wrong
description: He packed the laptop and the chargers, because he was thinking about work. Two years later in another country, he needs his grandfather's land deed and his mother's medical file, and both are in a drawer in a building that no longer stands.
energy_note: Punished for what you thought about under pressure.

aspect: Shelter is not safety, it is a different set of problems
description: Communal shelter removes privacy, sleep, sanitation and any control over who is near your children. The stress profile changes; it does not fall.
energy_note: Out of danger, into no walls at all.

aspect: The place you return to is not the place you left
description: Return is the stated goal for years. When it happens the street is different, the neighbours are gone, and the person discovers that the thing they wanted back was a time, not a location.
energy_note: Going home and finding it was never a place.
